title: Controllable Diverse Sampling through Pullback Directions
abstract: arXiv:2610.14294v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conditional diffusion models can generate high-quality images that align closely with a given prompt. However, samples generated from different random seeds may remain visually similar, limiting creative exploration. Existing approaches can increase variation, but often require additional optimization or sampling overhead, while stronger perturbations may introduce distortions that degrade image quality or prompt alignment. We propose a training-free method that leverages the local pullback geometry induced by the mapping from the conditioning-embedding space to the image space to identify directions of maximal output sensitivity. By steering different sampling trajectories along these directions, we encourage distinct generations while maintaining consistency with the conditioning signal. Experiments on MS-COCO and BrushNet show the efficacy of the method in improving diversity on prompt-conditioned image generation and inpainting.

translated_title: 通过拉回方向实现可控多样性采样
translated_abstract: 条件扩散模型能够生成与给定提示词高度契合的高质量图像。然而，从不同随机种子生成的样本可能在视觉上仍然相似，这限制了创作探索。现有方法虽然可以增加变化，但通常需要额外的优化或采样开销，而较强的扰动可能引入失真，从而降低图像质量或提示词一致性。我们提出了一种无需训练的方法，利用从条件嵌入空间到图像空间的映射所诱导的局部拉回几何，来识别输出敏感性最大的方向。通过沿这些方向引导不同的采样轨迹，我们在保持与条件信号一致性的同时，鼓励生成各不相同的结果。在MS-COCO和BrushNet上的实验表明，该方法在提升提示条件图像生成与图像修复的多样性方面是有效的。
tldr: 该论文提出一种无需训练的方法，通过利用条件嵌入空间到图像空间的局部拉回几何来识别最大输出敏感方向，在保持提示词一致性的同时有效增强扩散模型图像生成与修复的多样性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a training-free method that leverages the local pullback geometry induced by the mapping from conditioning-embedding space to image space to identify directions of maximal output sensitivity, enhancing diversity in prompt-conditioned diffusion image generation and inpainting while maintaining prompt alignment.
